note: Recreation-district camper park on the east edge of Rangely at 940 E. Rangely Ave, in a cottonwood grove with stocked fishing ponds, White River access, a large gazebo, sand volleyball and horseshoe pits. --Claude
summary: Operator (Western Rio Blanco Metro Rec & Park District) page + Town of Rangely contact page: confirmed showers, dump, first-come only, 14-day limit. Changed site count 26 -> 23 (13 with electric); added fees $20 / $30 (electric). Amperage, lengths and season not stated. Note: dropped the old $15/$20 rates and the count/amenity/FCFS restatements.
